root_cause_analysis: Meta API call failed with Error Code 4 and Subcode 2207051 (Action is blocked / Application request limit reached). The Instagram account or Meta App has hit automated activity limits or triggered anti-spam restrictions.
actionable_instructions: Pause automated publishing workflows for 24 hours to cool down API rate limits.
Log into the Meta Business Suite and Instagram app directly to check for account warning notices or restriction appeals.
